verses.decoded: When David returned from killing the Philistine, the women came out from all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing to meet King Saul, with tambourines, joy, and musical instruments.

verses.kjv: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
verses.decoded: And the women responded to each other while they were playing, saying, Saul has killed thousands, and David has killed tens of thousands.

verses.kjv: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.decoded: And Saul was very angry, and the statement upset him; and he said, They have credited David with ten thousands, and to me they have credited only thousands: and what else can he have except the kingdom?

verses.kjv: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.decoded: And Saul watched David closely from that day onward.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.
verses.decoded: The next day, the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David was playing the harp as he usually did, and Saul was holding a spear in his hand.

verses.kjv: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.decoded: Saul threw the spear because he said, I will strike David against the wall with it. But David dodged away from him twice.

verses.kjv: And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.decoded: Saul was afraid of David because the LORD was with David and had left Saul.

verses.kjv: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.decoded: So Saul took him away from his presence and appointed him as captain over a thousand men; and he led the people in and out.

verses.kjv: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him.
verses.decoded: And David acted wisely in everything he did, and the LORD was with him.

verses.kjv: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.decoded: Therefore, when Saul saw that David was acting very wisely, he became afraid of him.

verses.kjv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.decoded: But all Israel and Judah loved David because he went out and came back before them.

verses.kjv: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the Lord’s battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.decoded: And Saul said to David, Look, my older daughter Merab, I will give her to you as a wife; only be brave for me and fight the LORD’s battles. For Saul said, Let my hand not be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.decoded: And David said to Saul, Who am I? And what is my life or my father's family in Israel, that I should become the king's son-in-law?

verses.kjv: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.decoded: But when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given instead to Adriel the Meholathite as his wife.

verses.kjv: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.decoded: Michal, Saul's daughter, loved David, and when they told Saul, he was pleased.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
verses.decoded: And Saul said, I will give him her, so that she may be a trap for him, and the Philistines may attack him. Therefore Saul said to David, You will be my son-in-law today by marrying one of the two.

verses.kjv: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son in law.
verses.decoded: And Saul told his servants, saying, Talk with David privately, and say, Look, the king is pleased with you, and all his servants love you; so now become the king's son-in-law.

verses.kjv: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.decoded: And Saul’s servants said those words to David. And David said, Does it seem to you like a small thing to be the king’s son-in-law, when I am a poor man and not highly regarded?

verses.kjv: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.decoded: And Saul's servants told him, saying, David spoke like this.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: And Saul said, This is what you should say to David: The king does not want any bride price, but one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to take revenge on the king’s enemies. But Saul planned to cause David to be killed by the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son in law: and the days were not expired.
verses.decoded: When his servants told David these things, David was very happy to become the king’s son-in-law, and the time had not yet passed.

verses.kjv: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.decoded: Therefore David got up and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred Philistine men; and David brought their foreskins, and they were all counted and given to the king, so that David could become the king’s son-in-law. And Saul gave him Michal, his daughter, as a wife.

verses.kjv: And Saul saw and knew that the Lord was with David, and that Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.
verses.decoded: Saul saw and realized that the LORD was with David, and that Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

verses.kjv: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David’s enemy continually.
verses.decoded: Saul became even more afraid of David, and Saul was David’s enemy all the time.

verses.kjv: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the Philistines went out; and after they went out, David acted more wisely than all of Saul's servants, so his reputation was greatly respected.

verses.kjv: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.decoded: Saul spoke to his son Jonathan and to all his servants, telling them to kill David.

verses.kjv: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.decoded: But Jonathan, the son of Saul, really liked David; and Jonathan told David, "My father Saul is trying to kill you. So please be careful until morning, stay in a safe place, and hide yourself."

verses.kjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
verses.decoded: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and whatever I see, I will tell you.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.decoded: And Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father, and said to him, Do not let the king do wrong to his servant David; because he has not done wrong to you, and because his actions toward you have been very good.

verses.kjv: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.decoded: For he risked his life and killed the Philistine, and the LORD brought a great salvation for all Israel: you saw it and were happy; so why do you want to sin by shedding innocent blood and kill David without a reason?

verses.kjv: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the Lord liveth, he shall not be slain.
verses.decoded: And Saul listened to Jonathan's voice, and Saul swore, As the LORD lives, he will not be killed.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
verses.decoded: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him everything. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and David was with him, just like before.

verses.kjv: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
verses.decoded: There was war again, and David went out and fought against the Philistines, killing many of them in a great slaughter, and they ran away from him.

verses.kjv: And the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
verses.decoded: An evil spirit from the LORD came upon Saul while he was sitting in his house holding his spear, and David was playing music with his hand.

verses.kjv: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.decoded: Saul tried to kill David by throwing a spear at him near the wall, but David escaped from Saul's presence. Saul threw the spear into the wall, and David ran away and got away that night.

verses.kjv: Saul also sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David’s wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
verses.decoded: Saul also sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and kill him in the morning, but Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, If you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.

verses.kjv: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.decoded: So Michal lowered David down through a window, and he left, ran away, and got away safely.

verses.kjv: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
verses.decoded: And Michal took a statue, placed it in the bed, put a pillow made of goat hair as a cushion, and covered it with a cloth.

verses.kjv: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.decoded: When Saul sent messengers to capture David, she said, He is sick.

verses.kjv: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.decoded: Saul sent the messengers again to watch David, saying, Bring him to me in bed so I can kill him.

verses.kjv: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.
verses.decoded: And when the messengers came in, look, there was a figure in the bed, with a pillow made of goats' hair for his headrest.

verses.kjv: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.decoded: And Saul said to Michal, Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go so that he escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said to me, Let me go; why should I kill you?

verses.kjv: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.decoded: So David ran away and escaped, and went to Samuel at Ramah, and told him everything that Saul had done to him. Then David and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

verses.kjv: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.decoded: Saul was told, "Look, David is at Naioth in Ramah."

verses.kjv: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.decoded: Saul sent messengers to capture David, but when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing as their leader, the Spirit of God came upon Saul's messengers, and they also began to prophesy.

verses.kjv: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.decoded: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers a third time, and they also prophesied.

verses.kjv: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.decoded: Then he also went to Ramah and came to a large well in Sechu. He asked, 'Where are Samuel and David?' Someone answered, 'They are at Naioth in Ramah.'

verses.kjv: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.decoded: And he went there to Naioth in Ramah, and the Spirit of God was on him as well, and he continued, and prophesied until he arrived at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.kjv: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.decoded: He also took off his clothes and prophesied in front of Samuel just like that, and he stayed lying naked all day and all night. That is why people say, "Is Saul also one of the prophets?"

verses.kjv: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.decoded: And David ran away from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, What have I done? What wrong have I committed? What sin have I done against your father that he is trying to kill me?

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, God forbid; you will not die: look, my father will not do anything great or small without telling me; so why would my father hide this from me? It is not true.

verses.kjv: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.decoded: And David also swore and said, Your father certainly knows that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, Do not let Jonathan know this, so that he will not be upset: but truly, as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is only a step between me and death.

verses.kjv: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.decoded: Then Jonathan said to David, Whatever your heart desires, I will do it for you.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.decoded: And David said to Jonathan, Look, tomorrow is the new moon, and I am supposed to sit with the king at the meal; but let me go and hide myself in the field until the third day evening.

verses.kjv: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.decoded: If your father misses me at all, then say, David urgently asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem, his hometown, because there is an annual sacrifice there for the whole family.

verses.kjv: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.decoded: If he says this, It is well; your servant will have peace: but if he is very angry, then be sure that he has decided on something bad.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.decoded: Therefore you should be kind to your servant; because you have made a covenant of the LORD with me. However, if there is sin in me, kill me yourself; because why should you bring me to your father?

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.decoded: And Jonathan said, Absolutely not; if I knew for sure that my father planned to harm you, would I not tell you?

verses.kjv: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.decoded: Then David said to Jonathan, Who will tell me? Or what if your father answers you harshly?

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan said to David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they both went out into the field.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, O Lord God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.decoded: And Jonathan said to David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have asked my father tomorrow at any time, or the third day, and, look, if there is good news for David, and I do not send to you and show it to you;

verses.kjv: The Lord do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the Lord be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.decoded: May the LORD do the same and even more to Jonathan; but if my father intends to harm you, then I will tell you and send you away so that you can go in peace. May the LORD be with you, just as he has been with my father.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the Lord, that I die not:
verses.decoded: And you will not only show me the kindness of the LORD while I am still alive, so that I do not die:

verses.kjv: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the Lord hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: But you must not stop showing kindness to my family forever; not even when the LORD has destroyed all of David's enemies from the earth.

verses.kjv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the Lord even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.
verses.decoded: So Jonathan made an agreement with David's family, saying, May the LORD demand this from David's enemies.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan made David swear again, because he loved him; for he loved him as much as he loved his own life.

verses.kjv: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.decoded: Then Jonathan said to David, Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed because your seat will be empty.

verses.kjv: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.decoded: And after you have stayed three days, then you will go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when the matter was happening, and you will stay by the stone Ezel.

verses.kjv: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.decoded: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as if I were aiming at a target.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the Lord liveth.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send a boy and tell him, 'Go, find the arrows.' If I specifically say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are on this side of you, take them,' then come to me, because it means there is peace for you and no danger; as the LORD lives.

verses.kjv: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.
verses.decoded: But if I say this to the young man, 'Look, the arrows are beyond you; go on your way,' because the LORD has sent you away.

verses.kjv: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever.
verses.decoded: And concerning the matter that you and I have talked about, the LORD will be between you and me forever.

verses.kjv: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.decoded: So David hid himself in the field, and when the new moon arrived, the king sat down to eat meat.

verses.kjv: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.
verses.decoded: The king sat on his throne, as usual, on a seat by the wall. Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David’s seat was empty.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.decoded: Nevertheless, Saul did not say anything that day because he thought, Something has happened to him; he is unclean; surely he is unclean.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.decoded: The next day, which was the second day of the month, David's seat was empty. Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why hasn't the son of Jesse come to the meal, neither yesterday nor today?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:
verses.decoded: And Jonathan answered Saul, David urgently asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem:

verses.kjv: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.
verses.decoded: And he said, Let me go, please; because our family has a sacrifice in the city; and my brother has commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me leave and see my brothers. Therefore he does not come to the king’s table.

verses.kjv: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?
verses.decoded: Then Saul became very angry with Jonathan and said to him, You son of a stubborn and rebellious woman, do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to bring shame upon yourself and to disgrace your mother?

verses.kjv: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.decoded: As long as the son of Jesse is alive on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. So now send and bring him to me, because he will definitely die.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.decoded: And Jonathan answered Saul his father and said to him, Why should he be killed? What has he done?

verses.kjv: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.decoded: And Saul threw a spear at him to kill him, which made Jonathan realize that his father had decided to kill David.

verses.kjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.decoded: So Jonathan got up from the table very angry, and he did not eat any food on the second day of the month because he was upset for David, since his father had shamed him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.decoded: The next morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the agreed time with David, and a young boy was with him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.decoded: And he said to his servant, Run and find the arrows that I shoot now. As the servant ran, he shot an arrow past him.

verses.kjv: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.decoded: When the boy reached the spot where Jonathan had shot the arrow, Jonathan called out to the boy and said, "Isn't the arrow past you?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan shouted to the boy, Hurry, be quick, do not stop. And Jonathan’s boy picked up the arrows and went to his master.

verses.kjv: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.decoded: But the young man did not know anything; only Jonathan and David knew what was going on.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his servant and said to him, Go, take them to the city.

verses.kjv: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.decoded: As soon as the young man left, David got up from a place toward the south, lay face down on the ground, and bowed three times. Then they kissed each other and cried together until David cried more than the other.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD will be between me and you, and between my descendants and your descendants forever. Then he got up and left, and Jonathan went into the city.

verses.kjv: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
verses.decoded: Then David went to Nob to see Ahimelech the priest, and Ahimelech was afraid when he saw David and asked him, "Why are you alone? Where are the others with you?"

verses.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
verses.decoded: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king has given me a task and told me, Let no one know anything about the task I am sending you on or what I have commanded you; and I have assigned my servants to certain places.

verses.kjv: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
verses.decoded: Now then, what do you have with you? Give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.

verses.kjv: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
verses.decoded: The priest answered David and said, There is no regular bread here, but there is holy bread; if the young men have kept themselves from women.

verses.kjv: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
verses.decoded: And David answered the priest and said to him, Truly, women have been kept from us for about three days since I left, and the bodies of the young men are pure, and the bread is considered ordinary, even though it was made holy today in the container.

verses.kjv: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the Lord, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.decoded: So the priest gave him consecrated bread because there was no other bread there except the showbread, which had been taken from before the LORD to be replaced with hot bread on the day it was removed.

verses.kjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.decoded: Now a certain man who was one of Saul's servants was there that day, serving before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chief of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.
verses.decoded: And David said to Ahimelech, "Is there not a spear or sword here at your disposal? For I did not bring my sword or weapons with me, because the king’s business required me to hurry."

verses.kjv: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.decoded: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, look, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if you want to take it, take it, because there is no other one here except this. And David said, There is none like it; give it to me.

verses.kjv: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.decoded: And David got up and ran away that day because he was afraid of Saul, and he went to Achish, the king of Gath.

verses.kjv: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.decoded: And the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn't this David the king of the land? Didn't people sing to each other about him in dances, saying, 'Saul has killed his thousands, and David his ten thousands'?"

verses.kjv: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.decoded: And David remembered these words deeply, and was very afraid of Achish, the king of Gath.

verses.kjv: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.decoded: He changed his behavior in front of them, pretended to be insane while they were watching, scratched at the doors of the gate, and let his saliva fall down onto his beard.

verses.kjv: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
verses.decoded: Then Achish said to his servants, Look, you see the man is insane; why then have you brought him to me?

verses.kjv: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.decoded: Do I need crazy people, that you have brought this man to act crazy in front of me? Should this man come into my house?

verses.kjv: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.decoded: David left that place and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and all his family heard about it, they went down there to him.

verses.kjv: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.decoded: Everyone who was in trouble, everyone who owed money, and everyone who was unhappy gathered around him; and he became their leader, and about four hundred men were with him.

verses.kjv: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
verses.decoded: And David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king of Moab, Please allow my father and my mother to come and stay with you until I find out what God will do for me.

verses.kjv: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
verses.decoded: He brought them to the king of Moab, and they lived with him for as long as David was hiding in the cave.

verses.kjv: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
verses.decoded: And the prophet Gad said to David, Do not stay in the stronghold; leave and go into the land of Judah. So David left and went to the forest of Hareth.

verses.kjv: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
verses.decoded: When Saul heard that David and the men with him had been found, (now Saul was staying in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, holding his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him;)

verses.kjv: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
verses.decoded: Then Saul said to his servants who were standing around him, Listen now, you Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give each of you fields and vineyards, and make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?

verses.kjv: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.decoded: Have all of you conspired against me, and is there no one who tells me that my son has made a pact with the son of Jesse? Is there no one among you who feels sorry for me or tells me that my son has incited my servant against me to ambush me, as is happening today?

verses.kjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.decoded: Then Doeg the Edomite, who was in charge of Saul's servants, answered and said, I saw the son of Jesse going to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

verses.kjv: And he inquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.decoded: And he asked the LORD about him, and gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

verses.kjv: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.decoded: Then the king sent for Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all the priests from his family who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.decoded: And Saul said, Listen now, son of Ahitub. And he answered, I am here, my lord.

verses.kjv: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.decoded: And Saul said to him, Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, by giving him bread and a sword, and by asking God about him, so that he would rise against me and lie in wait, as he does today?

verses.kjv: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
verses.decoded: Then Ahimelech answered the king and said, Who among all your servants is as faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, follows your commands, and is respected in your house?

verses.kjv: Did I then begin to inquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.decoded: Did I start to ask God about him? Absolutely not. Let the king not blame his servant or anyone in my family for this, because your servant knew nothing about any of this, whether less or more.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father’s house.
verses.decoded: And the king said, You will definitely die, Ahimelech, you and all your family.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the Lord; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the king said to the soldiers standing around him, "Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because they are also supporting David, and because they knew when he escaped and did not tell me." But the king's servants refused to raise their hand to attack the priests of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Doeg, Turn around and attack the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned and attacked the priests, and on that day he killed eighty-five people who were wearing linen ephods.

verses.kjv: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.decoded: And he struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the sword, killing men and women, children and babies, as well as oxen, donkeys, and sheep, with the sword.

verses.kjv: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.decoded: One of the sons of Ahimelech, who was the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and ran away to join David.

verses.kjv: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the Lord’s priests.
verses.decoded: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the LORD’S priests.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father’s house.
verses.decoded: And David said to Abiathar, I knew on that day when Doeg the Edomite was there that he would definitely tell Saul: I have caused the death of all the members of your father's family.

verses.kjv: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
verses.decoded: Stay with me, do not be afraid: because the one who wants to kill me also wants to kill you: but with me you will be safe.

verses.kjv: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
verses.decoded: Then they told David, saying, Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are stealing from the threshing floors.

verses.kjv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.decoded: So David asked the LORD, 'Should I go and attack these Philistines?' And the LORD told David, 'Go and attack the Philistines and rescue Keilah.'

verses.kjv: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.decoded: And David’s men said to him, Look, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more will we be afraid if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

verses.kjv: Then David inquired of the Lord yet again. And the Lord answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.decoded: Then David asked the LORD again. And the LORD answered him and said, Get up, go down to Keilah; because I will give the Philistines into your hand.

verses.kjv: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.decoded: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought against the Philistines, took their cattle, and killed many of them. In this way, David saved the people living in Keilah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.decoded: When Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, escaped to David at Keilah, he came down holding an ephod.

verses.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
verses.decoded: And Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, God has delivered him into my hand; because he is trapped, having entered a town that has gates and bars.

verses.kjv: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.decoded: Saul gathered all the people for battle to march down to Keilah to surround David and his men.

verses.kjv: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.decoded: And David knew that Saul was secretly planning harm against him; so he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod here.

verses.kjv: Then said David, O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.decoded: Then David said, O LORD God of Israel, your servant has certainly heard that Saul is trying to come to Keilah to destroy the city because of me.

verses.kjv: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Lord God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, He will come down.
verses.decoded: Will the men of Keilah hand me over to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O LORD God of Israel, I ask you, please tell your servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

verses.kjv: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the Lord said, They will deliver thee up.
verses.decoded: Then David asked, Will the people of Keilah hand me and my men over to Saul? And the LORD said, They will hand you over.

verses.kjv: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.decoded: Then David and his men, about six hundred in number, got up and left Keilah, and went wherever they could go. And Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; so he stopped from going out.

verses.kjv: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
verses.decoded: And David stayed in the wilderness in fortified places, and stayed on a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul searched for him every day, but God did not allow him to be captured.

verses.kjv: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
verses.decoded: And David saw that Saul had come out to kill him, and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a forest.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, got up and went to David in the forest and encouraged him to trust in God.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, Do not be afraid, because the hand of Saul my father will not find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father also knows this.

verses.kjv: And they two made a covenant before the Lord: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.decoded: They both made an agreement before the LORD: David stayed in the forest, and Jonathan went to his home.

verses.kjv: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.decoded: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Isn't David hiding with us in the strongholds in the forest, on the hill of Hachilah, which is south of Jeshimon?"

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.
verses.decoded: So now, King, come down as much as you want to come down; and our job will be to hand him over to the king.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the Lord; for ye have compassion on me.
verses.decoded: And Saul said, May the LORD bless you; because you have shown kindness to me.

verses.kjv: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
verses.decoded: Go, please prepare again, and find out and see the place where he stays, and who has seen him there, because I have been told that he acts very cleverly.

verses.kjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
verses.decoded: So look carefully and find out all the hiding places where he is hiding himself, and come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search for him throughout all the regions of Judah.

verses.kjv: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.decoded: They got up and went to Ziph ahead of Saul, but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain south of Jeshimon.

verses.kjv: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.decoded: Saul and his men went to look for him. They told David, so he went down to a rock and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he chased after David in the wilderness of Maon.

verses.kjv: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.decoded: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men went on the other side of the mountain. David hurried to escape because he was afraid of Saul, since Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to capture them.

verses.kjv: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
verses.decoded: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, Hurry and come, because the Philistines have invaded the land.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
verses.decoded: So Saul stopped chasing David and went to fight against the Philistines. Because of this, they named that place Sela-hammahlekoth.

verses.kjv: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.
verses.decoded: And David went up from there and lived in fortified places at En-gedi.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.
verses.decoded: When Saul returned from chasing the Philistines, someone told him, 'Look, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.'

verses.kjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.decoded: Then Saul took three thousand selected men from all Israel and went to look for David and his men at the rocks where the wild goats live.

verses.kjv: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
verses.decoded: He came to the sheepfolds along the road, where there was a cave; and Saul went inside to relieve himself. David and his men stayed hidden on the sides of the cave.

verses.kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.
verses.decoded: And David's men said to him, Look, this is the day the LORD told you about, saying, I will put your enemy into your hands so you can do to him whatever you think is right. Then David got up and secretly cut off the edge of Saul's robe.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
verses.decoded: Afterward, David felt guilty because he had cut off a piece of Saul’s robe.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord’s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And he said to his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my master, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.

verses.kjv: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.decoded: So David stopped his servants with these words and did not allow them to attack Saul. But Saul got up out of the cave and continued on his way.

verses.kjv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
verses.decoded: David got up afterward, went out of the cave, and called out to Saul, saying, 'My lord the king.' When Saul looked back, David bowed down with his face to the ground and showed respect.

verses.kjv: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?
verses.decoded: And David said to Saul, Why do you listen to what people say, saying, Look, David is trying to harm you?

verses.kjv: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the Lord had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the Lord’s anointed.
verses.decoded: Look, today your eyes have seen how the LORD allowed you to be delivered into my hand in the cave today. Some told me to kill you, but I chose to spare you; and I said, I will not raise my hand against my lord because he is the LORD’s anointed.

verses.kjv: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, my father, look, yes, look at the edge of your robe in my hand: because I cut off the edge of your robe and did not kill you, understand and see that I have done no wrong or offense to you, and I have not sinned against you; yet you are trying to kill me.

verses.kjv: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD will judge between you and me, and the LORD will take revenge on you for me; but my hand will not be against you.

verses.kjv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.decoded: As the saying of the elders goes, Evil comes from evil people, but I will not harm you.

verses.kjv: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
verses.decoded: Who has the king of Israel come out after? Who are you chasing? After a dead dog, after a flea.

verses.kjv: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
verses.decoded: The LORD should be the judge and decide between me and you, look at the situation, defend my case, and rescue me from your hand.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.decoded: After David finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, "Is that your voice, my son David?" Then Saul raised his voice and cried.

verses.kjv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
verses.decoded: And he said to David, You are more righteous than I am, because you have treated me well, while I have treated you badly.

verses.kjv: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the Lord had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
verses.decoded: And you have shown today how you have treated me well: because when the LORD had delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.

verses.kjv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the Lord reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
verses.decoded: If a person finds his enemy, will he let him go without harm? Therefore, may the LORD reward you with good for what you have done to me today.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
verses.decoded: And now, look, I know very well that you will definitely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

verses.kjv: Swear now therefore unto me by the Lord, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.
verses.decoded: So now swear to me by the LORD that you will not kill my descendants after me, and that you will not destroy my name from my father's family.

verses.kjv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
verses.decoded: And David swore to Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

verses.kjv: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.decoded: Samuel died, and all the Israelites gathered together, mourned him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. Then David got up and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

verses.kjv: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.decoded: There was a man in Maon whose property was in Carmel; the man was very wealthy and had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. He was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.kjv: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
verses.decoded: The man's name was Nabal, and his wife's name was Abigail. She was an intelligent woman and very beautiful, but the man was rude and wicked in his actions. He belonged to the family of Caleb.

verses.kjv: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
verses.decoded: David heard while he was in the wilderness that Nabal had sheared his sheep.

verses.kjv: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
verses.decoded: And David sent out ten young men, and David said to the young men, Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

verses.kjv: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
verses.decoded: And this is what you will say to the one who lives in prosperity, Peace be to you, and peace be to your household, and peace be to everything you own.

verses.kjv: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.decoded: And now I have heard that you have shearers; your shepherds who were with us, we did not harm them, nor was anything missing from them while they were in Carmel.

verses.kjv: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
verses.decoded: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. So please let the young men find favor in your eyes, because we have come on a good day. Please give whatever you have to your servants and to your son David.

verses.kjv: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
verses.decoded: When David’s young men arrived, they spoke to Nabal using all those words in David’s name, and then they stopped.

verses.kjv: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
verses.decoded: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, Who is David? And who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants nowadays who leave their masters.

verses.kjv: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
verses.decoded: Should I then take my bread, my water, and the meat I have prepared for my workers, and give it to men whose origin I do not know?

verses.kjv: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
verses.decoded: So David’s young men turned around, went back, and came to him to report all those words.

verses.kjv: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
verses.decoded: And David said to his men, 'Each of you put on your sword.' So each man put on his sword, and David also put on his sword. About four hundred men went up with David, and two hundred stayed with the supplies.

verses.kjv: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
verses.decoded: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Look, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, and he insulted them.

verses.kjv: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
verses.decoded: But the men were very kind to us, and we were not harmed, nor did we lose anything, as long as we were with them when we were working in the fields.

verses.kjv: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.decoded: They protected us like a wall both day and night, as long as we were with them watching the sheep.

verses.kjv: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
verses.decoded: Now then, know and think about what you will do; because harm is planned against our master and all his household: for he is such a worthless person that no one can speak to him.

verses.kjv: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verses.decoded: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two bottles of wine, five prepared sheep, five measures of roasted grain, one hundred bunches of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and loaded them onto donkeys.

verses.kjv: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
verses.decoded: And she said to her servants, Go ahead of me; I am coming after you. But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

verses.kjv: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
verses.decoded: As she rode on the donkey, she came down through the hidden path of the hill, and David and his men came toward her; she met them.

verses.kjv: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
verses.decoded: Now David said, Surely I have kept all that this man has in the wilderness for nothing, so that nothing belonging to him was lost, and he has repaid me evil for good.

verses.kjv: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.decoded: May God do even more to the enemies of David if I leave by morning any of those who belong to him who urinate against the wall.

verses.kjv: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
verses.decoded: When Abigail saw David, she hurried, got off the donkey, fell on her face before David, and bowed down to the ground.

verses.kjv: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
verses.decoded: She fell at his feet and said, 'Let this wrongdoing be on me, my lord, let it be on me. Please let your servant speak to you and listen to the words of your servant.'

verses.kjv: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
verses.decoded: Please do not, my lord, pay attention to this worthless man, Nabal. Just as his name is, so is he; his name is Nabal, and foolishness is with him. But I, your servant, did not see the young men of my lord whom you sent.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the Lord hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
verses.decoded: So now, my lord, as the LORD lives and as your soul lives, since the LORD has kept you from coming to kill and from taking revenge with your own hand, let your enemies and those who want to harm my lord be like Nabal.

verses.kjv: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
verses.decoded: And now this gift that your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

verses.kjv: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.
verses.decoded: Please forgive the offense of your servant, because the LORD will definitely establish a secure family for my lord, since my lord fights the LORD's battles, and no evil has been found in you all your life.

verses.kjv: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
verses.decoded: But a man has risen to chase you and to try to kill you; however, the life of my lord will be protected and kept safe with the LORD your God, and the lives of your enemies, he will throw them away like stones from the center of a sling.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when the LORD has done for my lord everything good that he promised about you, and has made you ruler over Israel;

verses.kjv: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the Lord shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
verses.decoded: May this not be a cause of sorrow for you, nor cause your heart to be troubled, either because you have shed blood without reason, or because my lord has taken revenge. But when the LORD has done good things for my lord, then remember your servant.

verses.kjv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
verses.decoded: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me:

verses.kjv: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
verses.decoded: And blessed be your advice, and blessed be you, who have kept me today from coming to shed blood, and from taking revenge with my own hand.

verses.kjv: For in very deed, as the Lord God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.decoded: Truly, as the LORD God of Israel lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not hurried and come to meet me, by morning there would not have been anyone left alive in Nabal's household.

verses.kjv: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
verses.decoded: So David took from her hand what she had brought him, and said to her, Go in peace to your house; see, I have listened to your voice, and I have accepted you.

verses.kjv: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
verses.decoded: And Abigail went to Nabal; and, look, he was having a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was joyful inside him, because he was very drunk: so she did not say anything to him, neither less nor more, until the morning light.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.decoded: But it happened in the morning, after the wine had left Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart stopped beating inside him, and he became like a stone.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.
verses.decoded: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, and he died.

verses.kjv: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
verses.decoded: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise the LORD, who has defended me against Nabal's insults and has kept me from doing wrong. The LORD has made Nabal suffer for his own evil." Then David sent for Abigail and spoke with her, asking her to become his wife.

verses.kjv: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
verses.decoded: When David's servants arrived at Abigail's place in Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, David sent us to you to marry you.

verses.kjv: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
verses.decoded: And she got up, and bowed down with her face to the ground, and said, Look, let your servant be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

verses.kjv: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.decoded: And Abigail hurried, got up, and rode on a donkey, with five of her young women following her; and she went after David's messengers, and became his wife.

verses.kjv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
verses.decoded: David also married Ahinoam from Jezreel, and both of them were his wives.

verses.kjv: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
verses.decoded: But Saul had given Michal, his daughter and David’s wife, to Phalti, the son of Laish, who was from Gallim.

verses.kjv: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
verses.decoded: The Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Isn't David hiding on the hill of Hachilah, which is in front of Jeshimon?"

verses.kjv: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.decoded: Then Saul got up and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, taking three thousand of Israel's best men with him, to look for David in the wilderness of Ziph.

verses.kjv: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Saul camped on the hill of Hachilah, which is in front of Jeshimon, along the road. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul was coming after him into the wilderness.

verses.kjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
verses.decoded: David sent out spies and found out that Saul had really arrived.

verses.kjv: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
verses.decoded: And David got up and went to the place where Saul had set up camp; and David saw the place where Saul was lying, and Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army; and Saul was lying in the trench, and the people were camped all around him.

verses.kjv: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.
verses.decoded: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul at the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.

verses.kjv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
verses.decoded: So David and Abishai went to the camp at night, and Saul was sleeping inside the trench, with his spear stuck in the ground near his pillow; but Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.

verses.kjv: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.
verses.decoded: Then Abishai said to David, God has given your enemy into your hand today; so now let me strike him with the spear to the ground once, and I will not strike him a second time.

verses.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord’s anointed, and be guiltless?
verses.decoded: And David said to Abishai, Do not kill him, because who can raise their hand against the Lord’s chosen one and be without guilt?

verses.kjv: David said furthermore, As the Lord liveth, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
verses.decoded: David said furthermore, As the LORD lives, the LORD will strike him; or his time to die will come; or he will go down to battle and be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The Lord forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the Lord’s anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
verses.decoded: May the LORD forbid that I should reach out my hand against the LORD’S anointed; but please, take now the spear that is at his pillow, and the jar of water, and let us go.

verses.kjv: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the Lord was fallen upon them.
verses.decoded: So David took the spear and the water container from Saul’s pillow; and they left, and no one saw it, nor knew it, nor woke up: because they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.

verses.kjv: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:
