verses.decoded: Then David crossed to the other side and stood on top of a hill far away; there was a large distance between them.

verses.kjv: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?
verses.decoded: And David shouted to the people and to Abner son of Ner, saying, "Aren't you going to answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered and said, "Who are you to shout to the king?"

verses.kjv: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.
verses.decoded: And David said to Abner, Aren't you a brave man? And who is like you in Israel? So why haven't you protected your lord the king? Because someone from the people came in to kill the king your lord.

verses.kjv: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the Lord liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the Lord’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.
verses.decoded: What you have done is not good. As the LORD lives, you deserve to die because you did not protect your master, the LORD’S anointed. Now look where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was by his pillow.

verses.kjv: And Saul knew David’s voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.
verses.decoded: And Saul recognized David’s voice and said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And David said, "It is my voice, my lord, O king."

verses.kjv: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?
verses.decoded: And he said, Why does my lord chase after his servant like this? What have I done? What wrong is in my hand?

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the Lord have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the Lord; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.
verses.decoded: Now, please, let my lord the king listen to the words of his servant. If the LORD has caused you to be against me, let him accept an offering; but if it is people who have done this, may they be cursed before the LORD, because they have forced me today to leave the inheritance of the LORD, saying, Go, serve other gods.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.
verses.decoded: So now, please do not let my blood be shed on the ground in the presence of the LORD, because the king of Israel has come out to chase something insignificant, like someone hunting a partridge in the mountains.

verses.kjv: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
verses.decoded: Then Saul said, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no longer harm you, because my life was valuable in your eyes today: see, I have acted foolishly and made a great mistake.

verses.kjv: And David answered and said, Behold the king’s spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
verses.decoded: And David answered and said, Look at the king’s spear! Let one of the young men come and get it.

verses.kjv: The Lord render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the Lord delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the Lord’s anointed.
verses.decoded: The LORD will give to each person what they deserve for their righteousness and faithfulness: because the LORD allowed you to be captured by me today, but I refused to raise my hand against the LORD’s chosen one.

verses.kjv: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
verses.decoded: And look, just as I have valued your life greatly today in my eyes, may my life be greatly valued in the eyes of the LORD, and may he rescue me from all trouble.

verses.kjv: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.decoded: Then Saul said to David, Blessed are you, my son David: you will do great things and will continue to succeed. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

verses.kjv: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.
verses.decoded: And David thought to himself, I will be killed one day by Saul's hand; it is better for me to quickly escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up trying to find me anywhere in Israel, and I will be safe from him.

verses.kjv: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.decoded: And David got up, and he went over with the six hundred men who were with him to Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

verses.kjv: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
verses.decoded: David lived with Achish in Gath, he and his men, each man with his family, including David with his two wives, Ahinoam from Jezreel, and Abigail from Carmel, who was Nabal’s wife.

verses.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
verses.decoded: Saul was told that David had escaped to Gath, and he did not look for him anymore.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?
verses.decoded: And David said to Achish, If I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the countryside so I can live there, because why should your servant live in the royal city with you?

verses.kjv: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
verses.decoded: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day; therefore, Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah up to this day.

verses.kjv: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
verses.decoded: David lived in the land of the Philistines for a full year and four months.

verses.kjv: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: David and his men went up and attacked the Geshurites, the Gezrites, and the Amalekites, because those nations had lived in the land long ago, from the area near Shur all the way to the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
verses.decoded: And David attacked the land, leaving no man or woman alive, and took the sheep, the oxen, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing, then returned and went to Achish.

verses.kjv: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
verses.decoded: And Achish said, Where have you made a raid today? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

verses.kjv: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: And David did not keep alive any man or woman to bring news to Gath, saying, 'They might report about us, saying, This is what David did, and this will be his behavior as long as he lives in the land of the Philistines.'

verses.kjv: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.
verses.decoded: And Achish believed David, saying, He has caused his people Israel to completely hate him; therefore he will be my servant forever.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
verses.decoded: At that time, the Philistines gathered their armies together to make war against Israel. Achish said to David, Be certain that you will go out with me to battle, you and your men.

verses.kjv: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.
verses.decoded: And David said to Achish, Surely you will know what your servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore I will make you the commander of my bodyguard forever.

verses.kjv: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
verses.decoded: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, his own city. And Saul had removed those who had familiar spirits and the wizards from the land.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
verses.decoded: The Philistines gathered together and camped at Shunem, and Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
verses.decoded: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart shook greatly.

verses.kjv: And when Saul inquired of the Lord, the Lord answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
verses.decoded: When Saul asked the LORD for guidance, the LORD did not answer him, neither through dreams, nor through the Urim, nor through prophets.

verses.kjv: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and inquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at En-dor.
verses.decoded: Then Saul said to his servants, Find me a woman who has a spirit medium, so I can go to her and ask her questions. His servants said to him, Look, there is a woman who has a spirit medium at Endor.

verses.kjv: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.
verses.decoded: And Saul disguised himself and put on different clothes, and he went with two men, and they came to the woman at night. He said, Please use your spirit medium to tell me the future and bring up the person I will name to you.

verses.kjv: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
verses.decoded: And the woman said to him, Look, you know what Saul has done, how he has removed those who have familiar spirits and the wizards from the land; so why are you setting a trap for my life to cause me to die?

verses.kjv: And Saul sware to her by the Lord, saying, As the Lord liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.
verses.decoded: And Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, As the LORD lives, no harm will come to you for this.

verses.kjv: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
verses.decoded: Then the woman said, Who should I bring up to you? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

verses.kjv: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.
verses.decoded: When the woman saw Samuel, she shouted loudly. Then she said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul."

verses.kjv: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
verses.decoded: And the king said to her, Do not be afraid: what did you see? And the woman said to Saul, I saw gods coming up out of the earth.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
verses.decoded: He asked her, What does he look like? She said, An old man is coming up; he is wrapped in a cloak. Saul realized that it was Samuel, and he bowed down with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.
verses.decoded: And Samuel said to Saul, Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up? And Saul answered, I am very distressed because the Philistines are making war against me, and God has left me and does not answer me anymore, neither through prophets nor through dreams. That is why I have called you, so that you may tell me what I should do.

verses.kjv: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the Lord is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?
verses.decoded: Then Samuel said, Why are you asking me, since the LORD has left you and has become your enemy?

verses.kjv: And the Lord hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the Lord hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:
verses.decoded: And the LORD has done to him as He spoke through me: for the LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

verses.kjv: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the Lord, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the Lord done this thing unto thee this day.
verses.decoded: Because you did not obey the voice of the LORD, nor carried out his fierce anger against Amalek, the LORD has done this to you today.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Lord will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the Lord also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, the LORD will also hand Israel over to the Philistines along with you; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The LORD will also hand the army of Israel over to the Philistines.

verses.kjv: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
verses.decoded: Then Saul immediately fell flat on the ground and was very afraid because of the words of Samuel; he had no strength left because he had not eaten any food all day or all night.

verses.kjv: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.
verses.decoded: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and she said to him, Look, your servant has obeyed your voice, and I have risked my life and have listened to the words you spoke to me.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.
verses.decoded: So now, I ask you, please listen to the voice of your servant woman, and let me put a piece of bread in front of you; and eat, so that you may have strength when you go on your way.

verses.kjv: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
verses.decoded: But he refused and said, I will not eat. However, his servants, along with the woman, forced him; and he listened to them. So he got up from the ground and sat on the bed.

verses.kjv: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
verses.decoded: The woman had a fat calf in the house; she hurried, killed it, took flour, kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread from it.

verses.kjv: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
verses.decoded: And she brought it to Saul and his servants, and they ate it. Then they got up and left that night.

verses.kjv: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
verses.decoded: Now the Philistines gathered all their armies at Aphek, and the Israelites camped by a spring in Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the Philistines went forward in groups of hundreds and thousands, but David and his men followed behind with Achish.

verses.kjv: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the Philistines said, What are these Hebrews doing here? And Achish said to the leaders of the Philistines, Isn't this David, the servant of Saul, the king of Israel, who has been with me these days or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he came to me until this day?

verses.kjv: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?
verses.decoded: The leaders of the Philistines were angry with him, and they said to him, Send this man back so that he can return to the place you assigned to him. Do not let him go with us to battle, because he might become an enemy to us during the fight. How could he make peace with his master? Wouldn't it be by taking the heads of these men?

verses.kjv: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.decoded: Isn't this David, the one they sang about to each other in dances, saying, Saul killed his thousands, and David his tens of thousands?

verses.kjv: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the Lord liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.
verses.decoded: Then Achish called David and said to him, Truly, as the LORD lives, you have been honest, and your coming and going with me in the army is good in my eyes: for I have not found any wrongdoing in you since the day you came to me until today: however, the leaders do not favor you.

verses.kjv: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: So now go back and leave in peace, so that you do not upset the leaders of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
verses.decoded: And David said to Achish, But what have I done? And what have you found in your servant as long as I have been with you until today, that I should not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

verses.kjv: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
verses.decoded: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that you are good in my eyes, like an angel of God: however, the leaders of the Philistines have said, He will not go with us to the battle.

verses.kjv: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master’s servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
verses.decoded: So now get up early in the morning with your master's servants who came with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and there is daylight, leave.

verses.kjv: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.decoded: So David and his men got up early in the morning to leave and return to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
verses.decoded: When David and his men arrived at Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had attacked the southern area and Ziklag, had defeated Ziklag, and set it on fire;

verses.kjv: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
verses.decoded: They had taken the women who were there as captives; they did not kill anyone, whether old or young, but took them away and continued on their way.

verses.kjv: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
verses.decoded: So David and his men came to the city, and they saw that it was burned with fire; and their wives, sons, and daughters had been taken captive.

verses.kjv: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
verses.decoded: Then David and the people with him raised their voices and cried until they could not cry anymore.

verses.kjv: And David’s two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.decoded: David's two wives were captured: Ahinoam from Jezreel, and Abigail, who was the wife of Nabal from Carmel.

verses.kjv: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God.
verses.decoded: David was very upset because the people talked about throwing stones at him, since everyone was deeply troubled, each person grieving for his sons and daughters; but David found strength in the LORD his God.

verses.kjv: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
verses.decoded: And David said to Abiathar the priest, son of Ahimelech, Please bring me the ephod. And Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

verses.kjv: And David inquired at the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
verses.decoded: And David asked the LORD, saying, Should I chase after this group? Will I catch them? And the LORD answered him, Chase them, because you will definitely catch them and recover everything without fail.

verses.kjv: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
verses.decoded: So David went, along with the six hundred men who were with him, and they arrived at the brook Besor, where the people who had been left behind were staying.

verses.kjv: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
verses.decoded: But David chased after them, he and four hundred men; because two hundred stayed behind, they were so weak that they could not cross the brook Besor.

verses.kjv: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
verses.decoded: They found an Egyptian in the field, brought him to David, gave him bread, and he ate it; they also gave him water to drink.

verses.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
verses.decoded: They gave him a piece of a fig cake and two bunches of raisins. After he ate, his strength returned to him because he had not eaten any bread or drunk any water for three days and three nights.

verses.kjv: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
verses.decoded: And David said to him, Whose servant are you? And where do you come from? He said, I am a young man from Egypt, a servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me because I became sick three days ago.

verses.kjv: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
verses.decoded: We attacked the southern area of the Cherethites, and the region that belongs to Judah, and the southern part of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

verses.kjv: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
verses.decoded: And David said to him, Can you lead me to this group? And he said, Swear to me by God that you will neither kill me nor hand me over to my master, and I will lead you to this group.

verses.kjv: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
verses.decoded: And when he brought him down, look, they were scattered all over the land, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great loot they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.

verses.kjv: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
verses.decoded: And David attacked them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and not a single one of them escaped except four hundred young men who rode on camels and ran away.

verses.kjv: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verses.decoded: And David got back everything that the Amalekites had taken: and David saved his two wives.

verses.kjv: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
verses.decoded: Nothing was missing from them, not the young or the old, not sons or daughters, not any spoil or anything they had taken: David recovered everything.

verses.kjv: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.
verses.decoded: And David took all the sheep and cows, which they were driving in front of the other animals, and said, This is David’s loot.

verses.kjv: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
verses.decoded: David came to the two hundred men who were so weak that they could not follow him, and they had been left behind at the brook Besor. They went out to meet David and the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

verses.kjv: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
verses.decoded: Then all the wicked men and worthless men who were with David answered and said, Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoil that we have recovered, except to each man his wife and his children, so that they can take them and leave.

verses.kjv: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the Lord hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
verses.decoded: Then David said, You must not do that, my brothers, with what the LORD has given us, who has protected us and handed over the group that came against us into our hands.

verses.kjv: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verses.decoded: Who will listen to you about this? The share of the one who goes into battle will be the same as the share of the one who stays with the supplies; they will share equally.

verses.kjv: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
verses.decoded: And from that day forward, he made it a law and a rule for Israel up to this day.

verses.kjv: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the Lord;
verses.decoded: When David arrived at Ziklag, he sent some of the loot to the leaders of Judah, to his friends, saying, Here is a gift for you from the loot taken from the enemies of the LORD;

verses.kjv: To them which were in Beth-el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
verses.decoded: To those who were in Bethel, and to those who were in south Ramoth, and to those who were in Jattir,

verses.kjv: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
verses.decoded: And to the people who were in Aroer, and to the people who were in Siphmoth, and to the people who were in Eshtemoa,

verses.kjv: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.decoded: And to the people who were in Rachal, and to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

verses.kjv: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chor-ashan, and to them which were in Athach,
verses.decoded: And to those who were in Hormah, and to those who were in Chor-ashan, and to those who were in Athach,

verses.kjv: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
verses.decoded: And to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David and his men used to stay.

verses.kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.decoded: The Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel ran away from the Philistines and were killed on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul’s sons.
verses.decoded: The Philistines chased closely after Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Melchi-shua, Saul’s sons.

verses.kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
verses.decoded: The battle turned badly against Saul, and the archers shot him; he was seriously wounded by the archers.

verses.kjv: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.decoded: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me with it; otherwise these uncircumcised men will come and kill me and mistreat me." But his armor-bearer refused because he was very afraid. So Saul took a sword and fell on it.

verses.kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
verses.decoded: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died with him.

verses.kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
verses.decoded: So Saul died, along with his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his men, all on the same day.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.decoded: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those on the other side of the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel had run away, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and ran away; then the Philistines came and lived in those cities.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.decoded: The next day, when the Philistines came to take the bodies of those killed, they found Saul and his three sons dead on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
verses.decoded: They cut off his head, took off his armor, and sent it throughout the land of the Philistines to announce it in the temple of their idols and among the people.

verses.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.decoded: They placed his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.kjv: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
verses.decoded: When the people living in Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.kjv: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
verses.decoded: All the brave men got up and traveled all night. They took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, went to Jabesh, and burned them there.

verses.kjv: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.decoded: They took their bones and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.
